purpose: Evaluation of the frozen selection on the fixed test set. Method selection used development data only.

freeze.selection_rule: Highest fixed-dev official correct count among metadata methods. Include both already-evaluated reply methods as eligible fallbacks; pure BM25/Dense/hybrid remain content-only controls. Break ties with supported metadata-related repairs, then lower measured cost and simpler code. No test tuning.

dev_selection.reason: hybrid-meta ranked first by official dev correctness (65/179), grounded repairs (4), measured QA GPU-hours (0.574846) and the fixed method order.

cost.resource_note: Interrupted wall time comes from the outer budget ledger. Original CPU time, GPU peaks and index times were not saved. Stage timings cover recorded work only; the interrupted call has no complete question timing.

paired.caveat: Question-level p-value. Questions may share dialogues or question families.
